query.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT "$when" AS timestamp, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.vineyard_id') AS vineyard_id, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.parcel_name') AS parcel, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.ambient_temp_c') AS REAL) AS temp_c, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.humidity_pct') AS REAL) AS humidity_pct, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.soil_moisture_pct') AS REAL) AS soil_moisture_pct, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.leaf_wetness_hours') AS REAL) AS leaf_wetness_hrs FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'SensorVineyardReading' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 50) ORDER BY timestamp ASC

SELECT "$when" AS Advisory_Time, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.vineyard_id') AS Vineyard, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.botanical_health_score') AS REAL) AS Health_Score, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.fungal_risk_score') AS REAL) AS Fungal_Risk, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.harvest_readiness_index') AS REAL) AS Harvest_Index, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.frost_alert') AS Frost_Alert, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.action_recommendation') AS AI_Advice FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'VineyardHarvestAdvisory' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 20
